topic: How we work: from code change to live release (CI/CD)
caption:
How does a code change get from a developer's screen to your users, safely? Here's how we ship. 🚢

1️⃣ Every change is reviewed by another developer
2️⃣ Automated tests run on every change
3️⃣ Docker builds the same app every time
4️⃣ CI/CD deploys to a test environment first
5️⃣ Release with a way back if something goes wrong

Fewer surprises on release day, and all through our ISO-certified process. Swipe for each step. →

Want releases that don't keep you up at night? DM us SHIP and tell us about your product.

Share this with someone who dreads deploy day. 🔁

slides.title: From code change to live release.
slides.sub: How we ship updates without the release-day drama.

slides.title: Every change is reviewed.
slides.body: No code goes in unseen. A second developer reviews it for bugs, security and clarity before it's merged.

slides.title: Tests run automatically.
slides.body: Each change triggers automated tests, so a fix in one place doesn't quietly break another.

slides.title: Same build, every time.
slides.body: The app is packaged with Docker, so what we test is exactly what runs live. No “works on my machine”.

slides.title: Test environment first.
slides.body: CI/CD pipelines deploy to a test environment first, where the change is checked before real users see it.

slides.title: Release with a way back.
slides.body: We release to production on AWS with a plan to roll back quickly if anything looks wrong.

slides.title: Releases that don't keep you up.
slides.sub: Tell us about your product. We'll show you how we'd ship it.
